info.title: Hidden Fields API
info.description: Reads and updates YouTrack custom fields that are hidden from the YouTrack UI. The app calls YouTrack as a technical user that can see those fields, and returns only what the caller may get. Compatibility: released paths, parameters, operation ids, response fields and error codes are only ever added to, never renamed or removed, so ignore what you don't recognise. A breaking change gets a new path. An endpoint disabled in the app settings drops out of this document and answers 403 with error `disabled`.

servers.description: The YouTrack base URL, relative to this document

/api/extensionEndpoints/hidden-fields/gl.description: Works in every project you and the app's technical user can read, whether or not the app is attached to it.

parameters.name: issueId
parameters.description: The issue ID: readable, like ABC-1, or the database ID.

get.summary: Get an issue, including hidden fields
get.description: The issue in YouTrack's REST shape, with every custom field you can read plus the fields this app exposes although YouTrack hides them. Entries come in YouTrack's field order; match them by `name`.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Custom field names, separated by commas; put a name that contains a comma in double quotes. Matching ignores case and surrounding spaces. Only these fields are returned, and names that don't come back are listed in `missing`. Without it, the whole issue is returned.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: `true` returns every attribute YouTrack returns instead of the compact shape. Case-insensitive; any other value means compact.

400.description: `bad_request`: `issueId` is missing, or YouTrack rejected the request; its error is passed through.

401.description: No token, or an invalid one. YouTrack answers this itself, before the app runs.

403.description: `disabled`: this endpoint is disabled in the app settings.

404.description: `not_found`: the issue doesn't exist, or you can't see it.

500.description: `configuration_error`: the app's settings can't produce a YouTrack URL.

502.description: `upstream_error`: the technical user's call to YouTrack failed or returned an unexpected body.

post.description: Sets one custom field on the exposed list, as the technical user, so the issue history shows that user. You need permission to update the issue.

parameters.name: full
parameters.description: `true` returns every attribute YouTrack returns instead of the compact shape. Case-insensitive; any other value means compact.

200.description: A short status; with full=true, the updated field in the shape of get-issue with `fields`.

400.description: `bad_request`: `issueId` is missing, or the body isn't {"field": …, "value": …}, or YouTrack rejected the value; its error is passed through.

401.description: No token, or an invalid one. YouTrack answers this itself, before the app runs.

403.description: `disabled`: this endpoint is disabled in the app settings. `forbidden`: you are not in the allowed group, can't update the issue, or the field isn't exposed.

404.description: `not_found`: the issue doesn't exist or you can't see it, or the field isn't on this issue.

500.description: `configuration_error`: the app's settings can't produce a YouTrack URL.

502.description: `upstream_error`: the technical user's call to YouTrack failed or returned an unexpected body.

/api/issues/{id}/extensionEndpoints/hidd.description: Works only in projects the app is attached to; elsewhere YouTrack answers 404 "HTTP handler not found" before the app runs.

error.description: The app's codes are bad_request, disabled, forbidden, not_found, unsupported_media_type, configuration_error and upstream_error; errors from YouTrack itself keep YouTrack's own code.

Issue.description: An issue in YouTrack's REST shape. With `fields`, it has only idReadable, customFields and, when a name didn't come back, missing.

missing.description: Requested names that didn't come back, as given. A field that doesn't exist and one you may not get look the same.

value.description: Compact by default: the one attribute that identifies the value. `text` for text fields; `name` for enums, states, versions, builds, groups and owned fields; `login` for users; `presentation` for periods. Strings, numbers and dates (milliseconds since 1970) come as they are, multi-value fields as a list, and an empty field as null. With full=true, every attribute YouTrack returns.

field.description: The name of an exposed custom field.

value.description: The value in YouTrack's REST format for the field type: a string for string fields; {"text": "…"} for text; {"name": "Major"} for enum, state, version, build and owned fields (a list for multi-value fields); {"login": "jane"} for users; a number for integer and float; milliseconds since 1970 for dates; {"presentation": "1d 2h"} for periods. null clears the field.

field.description: The field's name as YouTrack spells it.
